blocks.content: The dean assigns you an important task: "I need a report on student enrollment. Can you find answers to these questions?

items: Which students are enrolled in courses?
Who hasn't enrolled in any course?
Are there any courses without students?
How can we see all students and all courses, even if they're not directly related?"

blocks.content: You can use SQL JOINs to tackle these questions effectively. Let's explore how.
